integrity: All source comparisons and in-package numerical checks described in the review were personally performed; proof uses exact sign-gauge, Gaussian Feynman–Kac and Green–Kubo arguments. Independent verification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The full-path law concerns the center-of-mass medium-entropy functional in the unconfined, steric-free, independent telegraph-sign/stationary-Gaussian OU branch. No total-entropy boundary term, variable-amplitude drive, correlated sign-relative coordinate, or arbitrary nonstationary preparation is covered.
title: An all-time entropy-process invariance despite switching-controlled transport in an active dimer
